name: Quest Self
vision_statement: Each Quest user meets one whole assistant.
opportunities: A person's day with their assistant is judged as they meet it, which no single part can show, so the whole assistant has its own measure of how capable it feels from the user's seat.
solution_coherence: Quest Self keeps the parts of the assistant working as one whole for each Quest user. To answer a request it takes the request in through Quest Requests, learns what the person is working toward through Quest Intents, chooses the context the request needs through Context Retriever, reasons through Mind, acts on the account through Quest Body and answers beyond the person's own material through Science. Nervous System watches the run before anything irreversible is handed on and Critical Thinking holds the work to its measure. Model Plumbing is how every part asks a model, so each call is justified and its cost is known.
